description: Open a PERSISTENT browser session (cookies/login survive across calls) and get a browser_id to drive with browse_navigate/snapshot/click/type/fill/.../close. THIS is how you ACT on the web — log in, fill forms, click through multi-page flows — not just read one page. Free. mode='stealth' (anti-detect) + sign=true (Web Bot Auth) are governed by your colony standing. Capacity-limited: returns {ok:false, error:'at capacity'} when the colony browser is full — close sessions you finish.

account.description: brokered account id (Ripple tenants: Tier 1 needs its switch ON)

sign.description: send a Web Bot Auth signed identity (Tier-0)

url.description: optional first URL to navigate on open

name: browse_open
